observer: Assistant inspection of the saved six-frame matched overview panels
scope: Two pre-existing failure examples, not a population success rate; six frames cannot exclude brief events between observations. Native64 is budget matched; R1-400 is the preserved quality reference.

cases.requested: Bend the plastic ruler until a visible fracture propagates.

observations.native64: Late broad white/dark fragments disrupt the foreground and clothing; no clean propagating stress fracture established in these views.
observations.r1_400: The horizontal object and people remain comparatively coherent, but the requested progressive bending/cracking is not established.
observations.r4_64: Fewer large floating fragments than native64; the horizontal object becomes a broad irregular strip and blends with the collar/foreground late. The selected views do not establish a credible propagating fracture.

cases.implication: Some stability improvement over native64 is visible, but R1 remains the stronger structural reference here; movement/deformation alone does not establish the requested material failure.

cases.requested: The mop passes through the puddle and water is removed from the swept region.

observations.native64: Mop shifts and lifts markedly; wet region remains prominent.
observations.r1_400: Late large loop-like dark strands or marks develop around the mop; removal of water is not established clearly in these views.
observations.r4_64: Mop head remains more compact than R1 in the late observations, with fewer large dark loops. The wet region remains prominent; a sustained cleared trail after the pass is not clearly established.

cases.implication: Improved tool shape is useful, but the requested water-removal process still needs to be learned.
